name: miraat
description: Find & fix the RTL mistakes AI code tools keep making — for Arabic, Hebrew, Syriac, Thaana, N’Ko & Adlam. AST-verified logical CSS, mirrored Tailwind utilities, an MCP server, and an AI-rules file so your agent stops reintroducing them. (formerly rtlint)
